scope: The Pyynikki Observation Tower and its connected ground-floor café at Näkötornintie 20, Tampere, as photographed in September 2011. The separate radio mast is excluded.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The Tampere tourism body records a 26 metre red granite tower that opened in 1929 and a café at ground level.
The Finnish Heritage Agency identifies Vilho Kolho as the architect and describes the tower as a Classical red granite structure 26 metres high.
